message.content: {"items": [{"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "The combined model achieves the lowest RMSE among all passing structures, indicating that position error is best explained by simultaneous sensor bias, velocity offset, and speed step effects.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "This two-factor model performs nearly as well as the triple model with lower complexity, supporting sensor bias coupled with a speed step as a strong explanation.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(VELOCITY_OFFSET,SPEED_STEP)", "rationale": "Velocity offset and speed step together yield very low RMSE, suggesting belt motion dynamics contribute significantly to the observed position deviations.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SPEED_STEP", "rationale": "As a single-factor model, SPEED_STEP achieves the lowest RMSE, indicating a discrete change in belt speed may be the primary driver of position error.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "AND(SENSOR_BIAS,VELOCITY_OFFSET)", "rationale": "The combination of sensor bias and velocity offset improves fit over single factors, supporting both measurement and motion contributions.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "VELOCITY_OFFSET", "rationale": "A constant velocity offset alone explains a substantial portion of the position error with low RMSE.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}, {"hypothesis_id": "SENSOR_BIAS", "rationale": "The position sensor was recently calibrated but stability should be checked; a constant sensor bias alone yields acceptable fit and is consistent with the context note.", "evidence_refs": ["obs:0:1.200"]}]}
